items.source:

items.translation: 如果容器处于listening状态，则停止消息监听器容器并取消任何订阅。

items.source: The default recovery interval: 5000 ms = 5 seconds.

items.translation: 默认订阅等待时间：2000 毫秒 = 2 秒。

Adds a message listener to the (potentially running) container. If the container is running, the listener starts
receiving (matching) messages as soon as possible.
items.translation: 向（可能正在运行的）容器添加消息监听器。如果容器正在运行，该监听器将尽快开始接收（匹配）消息。

items.source: Stop the message listener container and cancel any subscriptions if the container is listening. Stopping releases any allocated connections.
items.translation: 如果容器处于listening状态，则停止消息监听器容器并取消任何订阅。停止操作将释放所有已分配的连接。

items.source: This class can be used concurrently after initializing the container with afterPropertiesSet() and start() allowing concurrent calls to addMessageListener(MessageListener, Collection) and removeMessageListener(MessageListener, Collection) without external synchronization.
items.translation: 在通过 `afterPropertiesSet()` 和 `start()` 初始化容器后，该类可被并发使用，允许在不进行外部同步的情况下并发调用 `addMessageListener(MessageListener, Collection)` 和 `removeMessageListener(MessageListener, Collection)`。

items.source: Subscriptions are retried gracefully using BackOff that can be configured through setRecoveryInterval(long) until reaching the maximum number of attempts. Listener errors are handled through a ErrorHandler if configured.
items.translation: 订阅将使用 BackOff 优雅地重试，该配置可通过 setRecoveryInterval(long) 设置，直到达到最大尝试次数。如果已配置，监听器错误将通过 ErrorHandler 进行处理。

items.source: As opposed to the low-level Redis (one connection per subscription), the container uses only one connection that is 'multiplexed' for all registered listeners, the message dispatch being done through the task executor. It is recommended to configure the task executor (and subscription executor when using a blocking Redis connector) instead of using the default SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor for reuse of thread pools.
items.translation: 与低级别的 Redis（每个订阅一个连接）不同，容器仅使用一个连接，该连接通过任务执行器为所有注册的监听器进行“多路复用”，消息分发由此完成。建议配置任务执行器（在使用阻塞式 Redis 连接器时还需配置订阅执行器），以复用线程池，而不是使用默认的SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor。

items.source: The container uses a single Redis connection in a lazy fashion (the connection is used only if at least one listener is configured). Listeners can be registered eagerly before starting the container to subscribe to all registered topics upon startup. Listeners are guaranteed to be subscribed after the start() method returns.
items.translation: 容器以惰性方式使用单个 Redis 连接（仅当至少配置了一个监听器时才使用连接）。可以在调用starting之前急切地注册监听器，以便在启动时订阅所有已注册的 topic。保证在start()方法返回后，所有监听器均已订阅。

items.source: Listeners that wish to receive subscription/unsubscription callbacks in response to subscribe/unsubscribe commands can implement SubscriptionListener.
items.translation: 希望接收订阅/取消订阅命令响应的订阅/取消订阅回调的Listeners可以实现SubscriptionListener接口。

items.source: The default implementation builds a SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor with the specified bean name (or the class name, if no bean name specified) as thread name prefix.
items.translation: 默认实现会构建一个 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor，其线程名前缀为指定的 Bean 名称（若未指定 Bean 名称，则使用类名）。

items.source: This method is a potentially blocking method that blocks until a previous stop() is finished and until all previously registered listeners are successfully subscribed.
items.translation: 此方法为潜在阻塞方法，会一直阻塞，直到之前的stop()执行完毕，并且所有先前注册的监听器都成功订阅为止。

items.source:
Note: This implementation uses at most one long-running thread (depending on whether there are any listeners
registered or not) and up to two threads during the initial registration.
items.translation: 注意：此实现最多使用一个长运行线程（取决于是否注册了任何监听器），并在初始注册期间最多使用两个线程。

items.source:
Note: it's possible to call this method while the container is running forcing a reinitialization of the container.
Note however that this might cause some messages to be lost (while the container reinitializes) - hence calling
this method at runtime is considered advanced usage.
items.translation:
注意：可以在容器运行时调用此方法，从而强制重新初始化容器。  
但请注意，这可能会导致某些消息丢失（在容器重新初始化期间）——因此，在运行时调用此方法被视为高级用法。

items.source:
Multiple calls to this method are ignored if the container is already running. Concurrent calls to this method are
synchronized until the container is started up.
items.translation: 如果容器已经在运行，多次调用此方法将被忽略。在容器启动之前，对该方法的并发调用将得到同步处理。

items.source: The default implementation logs the exception at error level. This can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现会在错误级别记录该异常。此行为可在子类中重写。

items.source: Sets the serializer for converting the Topics into low-level channels and patterns. By default, StringRedisSerializer is used.
items.translation: 设置用于将 Topic 转换为低级通道和模式的序列化器。默认情况下，使用 StringRedisSerializer。

items.source: Specify the max time to wait for subscription registrations, in milliseconds The default is 2000ms, that is, 2 second.
items.translation: 指定等待订阅注册的超时时间，单位为毫秒。默认值为2000ms，即 2 秒。

items.source: Sets the serializer for converting the Topics into low-level channels and patterns.

items.source: Sets the task executor used for running the message listeners when messages are received. If no task executor is set, an instance of SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor will be used by default. The task executor can be adjusted depending on the work done by the listeners and the number of messages coming in.
items.translation: 设置用于在接收消息时运行消息监听器的任务执行器。如果未设置任务执行器，默认将使用 SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor 的实例。可以根据监听器执行的工作量以及传入消息的数量来调整该任务执行器。

items.source: Specify the max time to wait for subscription registrations, in milliseconds The default is 2000ms, that is, 2 second. The timeout applies for awaiting the subscription registration. Note that subscriptions can be created asynchronously and an expired timeout does not cancel the timeout.
items.translation: 指定等待订阅注册的超时时间，单位为毫秒。默认值为2000ms，即 2 秒。该超时机制适用于等待订阅注册完成。请注意，订阅的创建是异步进行的，因此超时的过期并不会取消正在进行的订阅创建操作。

items.translation: 配置该监听器容器是否在包含它的 ApplicationContext 刷新时自动启动。默认值为 true。

items.source:
Container providing asynchronous behaviour for Redis message listeners. Handles the low-level details of listening,
converting and message dispatching.
items.translation: 为 Redis 消息监听器提供异步行为的容器。负责处理监听、转换和消息分发的底层细节。

items.source: Sets the task execution used for subscribing to Redis channels. By default, if no executor is set, the setTaskExecutor(Executor) will be used. In some cases, this might be undesired as the listening to the connection is a long-running task.
items.translation: 设置用于订阅 Redis 通道的任务执行器。默认情况下，如果未设置执行器，将使用setTaskExecutor(Executor)。在某些情况下，这可能并不理想，因为监听连接是一个长期运行的任务。

items.source: Creates a default TaskExecutor. Called if no explicit TaskExecutor has been specified.
items.translation: 创建一个默认的 TaskExecutor。如果未显式指定 TaskExecutor，则调用此方法。
